title: Geography According to ChatGPT – How Generative AI Represents and Reasons about Geography

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's tendency to form geographic defaults by prompting it for generic categories (e.g., 'Name a country', 'name a zoo') at varying temperatures, and analyzing the spatial distribution and frequency of the generated locations.

Prompting the model to generate hypothetical demographic personas for a city, asking it to assign criminal records to these characters for a story, and comparing the racial and ethnic distribution of the chosen 'criminals' against real-world arrest statistics.
